deterministic_contract_scope: Requires a top-level executive_decision_basis, visible executive/decision section and explicit decision-question answers. The LLM remains responsible for semantic usefulness.

decision_questions.keep_system: Keep the compact onboarding service as the pilot subject because the source evidence is complete enough to explain the business flow and technical boundaries.
decision_questions.modernize_system: Modernize the decision policy, KYC client injection and scenario tests before copying the pattern to larger repositories.
decision_questions.replace_system: Do not replace the service based on this demo evidence; the visible risks are localized hardening items, not replacement drivers.
decision_questions.cost: Small engineering effort for policy extraction and KYC client injection; medium effort for scenario and production-readiness evidence.
biggest_risks: Hard-coded risk threshold can drift from configuration.
KYC client construction reduces testability and runtime control.
Scenario tests are placeholders, so process readiness remains partial.
next_actions: Turn placeholder onboarding scenarios into executable tests.

summary: The final report contains a visible executive decision layer before technical drilldown.
